{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: pr_run_test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - "main"
    paths-ignore:
      - "docs/**"
      - "**.md"
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron:  '56 01 * * *'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  BASE_SCORE: '{"MMBench_V11_MINI":{"Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct":0.76363636,"InternVL3-8B":0.92727273,"llava-onevision-qwen2-0.5b-ov-hf":0.45454545},"MMStar_MINI":{"Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct":0.6133333333333333,"InternVL3-8B":0.7,"llava-onevision-qwen2-0.5b-ov-hf":0.36},"AI2D_MINI":{"Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct":0.7651821862348178,"InternVL3-8B":0.8218623481781376,"llava-onevision-qwen2-0.5b-ov-hf":0.48582995951417},"OCRBench_MINI":{"Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct":15.7,"InternVL3-8B":17.3,"llava-onevision-qwen2-0.5b-ov-hf":5.5}}'
  HF_HUB_CACHE: /mnt/shared-storage-gpfs2/gpfs2-shared-public/huggingface/hub
  HF_HUB_OFFLINE: 1
  CONDA_PATH: /mnt/shared-storage-user/opencompass-shared/qa-llm-cicd/miniconda3
  CONDA_ENV: vlm_pr_test
  KUBEBRAIN_CLUSTER_ENTRY: https://h.pjlab.org.cn
  KUBEBRAIN_NAMESPACE: ailab-opencompass

jobs:
  vlm_test:
    if: ${{!cancelled()}}
    runs-on: [yidian_cu12_mllm]
    steps:
      - name: Clean workdir
        run: sudo git clean -ffdx
      - name: clone_repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-${{ runner.os }}- 
      - name: reinstall vlmeval
        run: |
          . ${{env.CONDA_PATH}}/bin/activate
          conda activate ${{env.CONDA_ENV}}
          pip uninstall vlmeval -y
          pip install .
          pip install numpy==1.23.0 transformers==4.57.1
      - name: evaluation_model
        run: |
          . ${{env.CONDA_PATH}}/bin/activate
          conda activate ${{env.CONDA_ENV}}
          pip list

          GPU_JOB=vllm-pr-test-${{ github.run_id }}-gpu-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          EVAL_ROOT=/mnt/shared-storage-user/mllm/qa-llm-cicd/eval_report/${{ github.run_id }}

          rjob submit \
            --metadata-name="$GPU_JOB" \
            --charged-group=llmeval_gpu_pool \
            --private-machine=group \
            --namespace=ailab-llmeval \
            --group=llmeval_gpu_pool \
            --gpu=1 --cpu=16 --memory=32568 \
            --image=registry.h.pjlab.org.cn/ailab-puyu-puyu_wsp_cpu/vlmevalkit:auto-v0.0.10 \
            --env=EVAL_ROOT="$EVAL_ROOT" \
            --env=PYTHONPATH="${{ github.workspace }}" \
            --env=PRED_FORMAT=tsv \
            --env=HF_HUB_CACHE=/mnt/shared-storage-gpfs2/gpfs2-shared-public/huggingface/hub \
            --env=HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 \
            --env=TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 \
            --env=LMUData=/mnt/shared-storage-user/opencompass-shared/qa-llm-cicd/LMUData \
            --mount=gpfs://gpfs1/qa-llm-cicd:/mnt/shared-storage-user/qa-llm-cicd \
            --mount=gpfs://gpfs1/opencompass-shared:/mnt/shared-storage-user/opencompass-shared \
            --mount=gpfs://gpfs1/auto-eval-pipeline:/mnt/shared-storage-user/auto-eval-pipeline \
            --mount=gpfs://gpfs2/gpfs2-shared-public:/mnt/shared-storage-gpfs2/gpfs2-shared-public \
            --mount=gpfs://gpfs1/mllm:/mnt/shared-storage-user/mllm \
            -- bash -ec '
              cd "${{ github.workspace }}"
              source "${{env.CONDA_PATH}}/bin/activate"
              conda activate "${{env.CONDA_ENV}}"
              export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"
              python run.py \
                --data MMBench_V11_MINI MMStar_MINI AI2D_MINI OCRBench_MINI \
                --model llava-onevision-qwen2-0.5b-ov-hf InternVL3-8B Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct \
                --work-dir "$EVAL_ROOT" \
                --reuse --judge exact_matching 2>&1
            '

          for i in {1..1200}; do
            current_status=$(rjob get --namespace=ailab-llmeval "$GPU_JOB" | grep -oP 'rjob [^:]+: \K[^ ]+')
            echo "Current status: $current_status, stop checking"
            if [[ $current_status == "Succeeded" ]]; then
              echo "Task succeeded"
              rjob logs job --namespace=ailab-llmeval "$GPU_JOB" -n 100
              exit 0
            elif [[ $current_status == "Failed" || $current_status == "Stopped" ]]; then
              echo "Task failed or stopped, fetching logs"
              rjob logs job --namespace=ailab-llmeval "$GPU_JOB"
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 6
          done
          rjob logs job --namespace=ailab-llmeval "$GPU_JOB" -n 100
          echo "Task timeout"
          exit 1
      - name: assert_result
        run: |
          . ${{env.CONDA_PATH}}/bin/activate
          conda activate ${{env.CONDA_ENV}}
          EVAL_ROOT=/mnt/shared-storage-user/mllm/qa-llm-cicd/eval_report/${{ github.run_id }}
          mkdir -p outputs
          for model in llava-onevision-qwen2-0.5b-ov-hf InternVL3-8B Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct; do
            cp -r "$EVAL_ROOT/$model" "outputs/$model"
            python .github/scripts/assert_score.py --dataset "MMBench_V11_MINI MMStar_MINI AI2D_MINI OCRBench_MINI" --base_score "$BASE_SCORE" --model-name "$model"
          done
      - name: stop job
        if: always()
        run: |
          rjob stop --namespace=ailab-llmeval vllm-pr-test-${{ github.run_id }}-gpu-${{ github.run_attempt }} || true

  vlm_api_test:
    if: ${{!cancelled()}}
    runs-on: [yidian_cu12_mllm]
    steps:
      - name: Clean workdir
        run: sudo git clean -ffdx
      - name: clone_repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-${{ runner.os }}- 
      - name: reinstall vlmeval
        run: |
          . ${{env.CONDA_PATH}}/bin/activate
          conda activate ${{env.CONDA_ENV}}
          pip uninstall vlmeval -y
          pip install .
          pip install numpy==1.23.0 transformers==4.57.1
      - name: evaluation_model
        run: |
          . ${{env.CONDA_PATH}}/bin/activate
          conda activate ${{env.CONDA_ENV}}
          pip list

          API_JOB=vllm-api-pr-test-${{ github.run_id }}-mock-api-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          EVAL_ROOT=/mnt/shared-storage-user/mllm/qa-llm-cicd/eval_report/${{ github.run_id }}

          rjob submit \
            --metadata-name="$API_JOB" \
            --charged-group=llmeval_gpu \
            --private-machine=group \
            --namespace=ailab-llmeval \
            --group=llmeval_gpu \
            --gpu=0 --cpu=16 --memory=24576 \
            --image=registry.h.pjlab.org.cn/ailab-puyu-puyu_wsp_cpu/vlmevalkit:auto-v0.0.10 \
            --env=EVAL_ROOT="$EVAL_ROOT" \
            --env=MOCK_SERVER="${{ github.workspace }}/.github/scripts/mock_chat_api.py" \
            --env=PYTHONPATH="${{ github.workspace }}" \
            --env=PRED_FORMAT=tsv \
            --env=HF_HUB_CACHE=/mnt/shared-storage-gpfs2/gpfs2-shared-public/huggingface/hub \
            --env=HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 \
            --env=LMUData=/mnt/shared-storage-user/auto-eval-pipeline/vlmeval/LMUData \
            --env=NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,0.0.0.0 \
            --mount=gpfs://gpfs1/qa-llm-cicd:/mnt/shared-storage-user/qa-llm-cicd \
            --mount=gpfs://gpfs1/opencompass-shared:/mnt/shared-storage-user/opencompass-shared \
            --mount=gpfs://gpfs1/auto-eval-pipeline:/mnt/shared-storage-user/auto-eval-pipeline \
            --mount=gpfs://gpfs2/gpfs2-shared-public:/mnt/shared-storage-gpfs2/gpfs2-shared-public \
            --mount=gpfs://gpfs1/mllm:/mnt/shared-storage-user/mllm \
            -- bash -ec '
              cd "${{ github.workspace }}"
              source "${{env.CONDA_PATH}}/bin/activate"
              conda activate "${{env.CONDA_ENV}}"
              bash .github/scripts/run_mock_api_tests.sh
            '

          for i in {1..1200}; do
            current_status=$(rjob get --namespace=ailab-llmeval "$API_JOB" | grep -oP 'rjob [^:]+: \K[^ ]+')
            echo "Current status: $current_status, stop checking"
            if [[ $current_status == "Succeeded" ]]; then
              echo "Task succeeded"
              rjob logs job --namespace=ailab-llmeval "$API_JOB" -n 100
              exit 0
            elif [[ $current_status == "Failed" || $current_status == "Stopped" ]]; then
              echo "Task failed or stopped, fetching logs"
              rjob logs job --namespace=ailab-llmeval "$API_JOB"
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 6
          done

          rjob logs job --namespace=ailab-llmeval "$API_JOB" -n 100
          echo "Task timeout"
          exit 1
      - name: assert_result
        run: |
          . ${{env.CONDA_PATH}}/bin/activate
          conda activate ${{env.CONDA_ENV}}
          bash .github/scripts/compare_mock_api_baseline.sh \
            /mnt/shared-storage-user/mllm/qa-llm-cicd/eval_report/${{ github.run_id }} \
            /mnt/shared-storage-user/mllm/qa-llm-cicd/eval_report/baseline_261104
      - name: stop job
        if: always()
        run: |
          rjob stop --namespace=ailab-llmeval vllm-api-pr-test-${{ github.run_id }}-mock-api-${{ github.run_attempt }} || true",

The repository has a `requirements.txt` that can serve as a cache key.
